status: normative architecture inventory; application implementation not yet complete
source_of_truth_rule: Exactly one normal-user write owner per scoped semantic fact. The canonical model/financial engine remains economic authority. Other pages only read and deep-link.
scope_note: Classify every rendered U1 normal/advanced field, including insurance, investment transactions and life-event operations, under its semantic family before release. New controls require controlled registry update.

records.label: People and household relationships
records.canonical_authority: Household.members; Person.household_id
records.resolution_policy: distinct people and dated relationships must remain distinct

records.label: Personal name and identity
records.canonical_authority: Person.first_name / last_name
records.resolution_policy: read-only echoes link to Person

records.label: Date of birth
records.canonical_authority: Person.date_of_birth
records.resolution_policy: birthdate is authoritative; never ask age as duplicate

records.label: Age on December 31
records.canonical_authority: date-of-birth and calendar computation
records.resolution_policy: show derived age read-only; missing/ambiguous birthdate requires person correction

records.label: Residence and effective location
records.canonical_authority: Person.residence_jurisdiction; dated tax facts where supported
records.resolution_policy: historical relocations stay separate by date; state tax residency is not inferred from current address

records.label: Tax filing status by year
records.canonical_authority: authoritative dated filing facts; existing contribution.policy.facts.filingStatus until normalized
records.resolution_policy: never derive from marital label alone; same year/filing-unit entry has one editor; historical tax filing differs from forecast assumption

records.label: HSA-qualified health coverage and eligibility
records.semantic_scope: person or family + dated coverage interval
records.canonical_authority: qualified coverage record or attested historical HSA facts
records.resolution_policy: do not assume HSA eligibility from having an HSA account; preserve partial-year and spouse differences

records.label: Employment, employer and sponsor identity
records.canonical_authority: Income.source/owner_id; employer/plan key binding
records.resolution_policy: employer ID reference is shared; never match two employers by unqualified display text

records.label: Salary, wages and gross/net pay basis
records.canonical_authority: Income.amount / frequency / gross_or_net / start_date / end_date
records.resolution_policy: record actual dated employment/pay contract; gross and net are different bases

records.label: Salary growth assumptions
records.canonical_authority: Income.growth_model_id -> Assumption / linked PrimitiveInstance
records.resolution_policy: edit beside linked salary; other Assumptions view is read-only deep link

records.label: Pay frequency and modeled deposit timing
records.canonical_authority: Income.frequency and supported payroll schedule
records.resolution_policy: do not infer observed deposit time or withholding from annual salary

records.label: Bank account receiving take-home pay
records.semantic_scope: household-level session execution routing for modeled recurring income; per-income account routing is not supported yet
records.canonical_authority: authoritative household execution cashFlowExecutionAccountId / income routing
records.resolution_policy: one forecast-session cash routing choice displayed beside Income; do not invent per-employer allocations; make session-only lifetime explicit

records.label: Earned wages per tax year
records.semantic_scope: person + employer + tax year + supported wage basis
records.canonical_authority: supported deterministic salary occurrence aggregation
records.resolution_policy: derive only for fully supported salary periods and basis; otherwise unknown/recorded evidence

records.label: Last year's wages from this employer
records.semantic_scope: person + employer sponsor + prior tax year
records.canonical_authority: completed prior-year payroll/wage history or explicit attested annual wage record
records.resolution_policy: never copy current salary into prior employer wages; distinct employers stay distinct

records.label: IRA-eligible annual compensation
records.semantic_scope: person or qualifying spouse + tax year
records.canonical_authority: supported legal eligible-compensation derivation or one recorded attested fact
records.resolution_policy: not identical to gross wages where exclusions or spousal rules apply; show provenance or missing rule

records.label: Roth IRA eligibility MAGI
records.canonical_authority: authoritative complete tax calculation or user-supplied supported tax worksheet
records.resolution_policy: gross salary is never substituted for MAGI; cannot derive unless tax coverage complete

records.label: Traditional IRA deduction MAGI
records.canonical_authority: authoritative complete tax calculation or user-supplied supported tax worksheet
records.resolution_policy: different legal test from Roth MAGI; no invented numbers

records.label: End of earned salary at retirement
records.canonical_authority: Income end_date if independently dated; linked approved retirement termination event
records.resolution_policy: a retirement event may stop linked salary only under existing explicit binding; do not conflate unrelated end dates

records.label: Recurring living and named expenses
records.canonical_authority: Expense.category / amount / frequency / start_date / end_date
records.resolution_policy: one expense entry; no duplicate mortgage/IRA/401k spending record

records.label: Spending growth/inflation assumptions
records.canonical_authority: Expense.growth_model_id -> linked Assumption/PrimitiveInstance
records.resolution_policy: edit beside expense; read-only global view links to expense

records.label: Expense payment cash account
records.canonical_authority: Expense.payment_account_id
records.resolution_policy: choose source checking/savings with expense and show cash impact once

records.label: Checking/savings details, ownership and opening balance
records.canonical_authority: Account.account_type / owner_id / opening_balance / opening_date
records.resolution_policy: Net Worth cash page summary is read-only and links here; opening cash not future bank balance

records.label: Bank interest terms and crediting basis
records.canonical_authority: Account interest terms and supported linked model
records.resolution_policy: interest yield from modeled terms not free-entered as extra income

records.label: IRA, brokerage, 401k, HSA account wrapper
records.canonical_authority: Account type / owner / opening wrapper cash / eligible tax classification
records.resolution_policy: cash Accounts page must not offer second retirement-account editor; account/holding distinction

records.label: Holding instrument identity, quantity, acquisition values
records.canonical_authority: Investment type/subtype/symbol, units/lots, applicable price/basis facts
records.resolution_policy: stock/option/bond subtype fields only when relevant; price and market valuation not coeditable alternatives

records.label: Market value / position value
records.canonical_authority: supported quantity × authoritative matching price or recorded valuation method
records.resolution_policy: derive if consistent price/date/multiplier; otherwise recorded valued-only source with basis/date, never guessed or dual editable

records.label: Projected holding return assumption
records.semantic_scope: holding/linked return model + scenario + effective interval
records.canonical_authority: Investment.return_model_id -> Assumption/PrimitiveInstance
records.resolution_policy: edit in holding, linked siblings update, read-only global list

records.label: IRA/brokerage planned purchases and cash-funded contributions
records.canonical_authority: durablePersonalPurchaseInstructions / bank source / character / amount / priority
records.resolution_policy: single account-context editor; mirrored outflow is transfer not expense or extra posting

records.label: 401k/workplace HSA employee/employer contribution elections
records.semantic_scope: person + employer/plan + holding + contribution type + year + policy
records.canonical_authority: durablePayrollAllocations; source linked gross salary
records.resolution_policy: edit with workplace account alongside its employer plan, not Current Plan; payroll withholding distinct

records.label: Employer retirement plan terms, Roth availability and limit-sharing bucket
records.canonical_authority: existing contribution plan policy employer key/planHasRoth and legal plan terms
records.resolution_policy: one plan-level editor, not repeated for every holding, employee and match contribution

records.label: Employer-plan eligible annual compensation
records.canonical_authority: authoritative plan-specific compensation definition applied to wage facts, else explicitly sourced eligible pay
records.resolution_policy: not automatically gross salary unless confirmed plan defines entire modeled wage basis

records.label: Prior year-to-date historical contribution totals
records.semantic_scope: actual holding/character/person/employer plan/tax year/cutoff; aggregate legal bucket across related holdings only for limits
records.canonical_authority: saved historical contribution usage/canonical observed transactions
records.resolution_policy: one observed historical amount per actual account/holding/character; capacity aggregates legal scopes; never infer historical usage from future plan

records.label: Annual retirement/HSA/IRA capacity & eligibility
records.semantic_scope: person/household + legal bucket + employer plan + year
records.canonical_authority: contribution law catalog + scoped fact resolver
records.resolution_policy: calculated read-only; only missing governing facts edited at their owner; cannot assign one whole policy snapshot authority

records.label: Future annual contribution eligibility
records.semantic_scope: person + legal bucket + plan + future year
records.canonical_authority: per-year qualified facts from dated source data and supported law
records.resolution_policy: remove global nominal carry-forward checkbox from normal authoring; unsupported MAGI/coverage remain unknown, not copied

records.label: Mortgage original terms, current balance and dates
records.canonical_authority: Liability.principal/current_balance/interest_rate/origination_date/maturity_date
records.resolution_policy: original principal and as-of balance are distinct facts; no current-balance derivation without complete dated payment history

records.label: Contractual scheduled mortgage payment
records.semantic_scope: liability + effective payment start + monthly term
records.canonical_authority: authoritative VS4 monthly mortgage execution terms + rule
records.resolution_policy: derive/display read-only when terms complete, never another editable monthly expense

records.label: Mortgage payment source, first due date and execution priority
records.canonical_authority: existing liabilityExecutionProfiles + ordered bank funding sources
records.resolution_policy: one normal edit beside mortgage; session execution bindings may remain session-only with explicit note

records.label: Extra principal, payoff and refinance decisions
records.canonical_authority: authorMortgageExtra / authorMortgageRefinance
records.resolution_policy: original debt terms remain separate from future event; no second cash deduction

records.label: Property/other physical asset purchase cost and owner
records.canonical_authority: Asset asset_type/owner_id/acquisition_cost/valuation_method
records.resolution_policy: property value and debt remain separate assets/liabilities, linked by collateral not duplicate equity entry

records.label: Current property value and growth assumption
records.canonical_authority: supported valuation method/dated source or linked assumption
records.resolution_policy: not silently same as purchase price; if recorded price vs derived future value different time bases

records.label: Retirement date and explicit income termination binding
records.canonical_authority: canonical retirement event + explicit RetirementTerminationBinding
records.resolution_policy: one retirement event editor; income editor links to event; do not duplicate separate arbitrary retirement age/date

records.label: Saved plan horizon and forecast run window
records.canonical_authority: Scenario.start_date/end_date; session simulationStart/End
records.resolution_policy: saved horizon and selected run window are different dated concepts, grouped one normal editor

records.label: Tax/forecast calendar year
records.semantic_scope: year from scenario + selected run interval
records.canonical_authority: Scenario/forecast clock
records.resolution_policy: derived year context only, not another manually keyed field

records.label: Forecast cash contention, projected law and run settings
records.canonical_authority: existing household execution and law policy
records.resolution_policy: only technical execution choices remain here, not duplicated salary/mortgage/account facts

records.label: Plan-wide assumptions listing
records.canonical_authority: projection of linked asset/income/expense assumptions
records.resolution_policy: read-only index with context edit links, never second editable field

records.label: Applicable versioned statutory limits and tax rules
records.canonical_authority: versioned TaxRule catalog / rule fingerprint
records.resolution_policy: not user-editable per household; unsupported rule years do not become invented law

records.label: Paycheck taxes actually withheld
records.canonical_authority: future authoritative wage withholding/settlement (#101)
records.resolution_policy: do not substitute computed annual tax liability or equal-per-month estimate

records.label: Tax payment/refund accounts and dates
records.semantic_scope: jurisdiction + tax year + settlement date/forecast scope
records.canonical_authority: current taxSettlementSetup; migrate editor to Taxes in #102
records.resolution_policy: one temporary editor until Taxes workspace; only one normal owner at a time

records.label: Your Paycheck monthly allocation
records.canonical_authority: read-only immutable monthly replay + qualified paycheck attribution
records.resolution_policy: proportional segments only for proven same-basis attributions; provisional/unallocated is not leftover; no independent money inputs

records.label: Net worth, cash movement and financial summaries
records.canonical_authority: authoritative posted ledger / reconciled forecast
records.resolution_policy: same transaction counted once; liabilities and transfers retain character

records.label: Sale or disposal of an owned investment position
records.semantic_scope: holding + account + scheduled event ID + scenario + execution date + quantity/lot selection
records.canonical_authority: existing D1 Event/EventEffect/PrimitiveInstance domain operation kind=sale; holding opening lots and exact settlement evidence
records.resolution_policy: Cash proceeds, realized gain and basis reduction are derived from one executed sale; user chooses disposition date/quantity/lot only where needed. No separately editable capital gain or duplicate cash receipt. Holding context is the only ordinary editor.

records.label: Exercise a supported long equity call
records.semantic_scope: owned option holding + linked underlying + account + event date + contract quantity + lot election
records.canonical_authority: existing D1 domain operation kind=call_exercise and authoritative option multiplier/strike/lot basis from holding
records.resolution_policy: Premium/basis, multiplier, strike and acquired underlying cost are derived when fully supported; require an explicit linked funding account and lot election only when economically material. Unsupported exercise/assignment is capability gated, not approximated.

records.label: Dividend or interest recognition and cash distribution
records.semantic_scope: income-producing holding + account + dated distribution event + tax character + actual/forecast source
records.canonical_authority: existing D1 domain operation kinds ordinary_dividend, qualified_dividend, interest with source-backed cash settlement
records.resolution_policy: Recognize actual or expressly scheduled distributions once; distinguish eligible qualified dividends from ordinary/interest and income from proceeds. Do not separately author an identical Income record or infer qualified tax character from the holding label. Date, tax character and amount come from this event.

records.label: Reinvest an identified investment dividend
records.semantic_scope: source holding + account + linked dividend income event + execution date + destination holding/quantity
records.canonical_authority: existing D1 domain operation kind=reinvest_dividend, linked dividend recognition followed by investment purchase
records.resolution_policy: One identified dividend event and one related purchase; never create a second dividend, generic contribution, extra bank expense or unsupported automatic recurrence. Reinvestment price/units derive where authoritative, otherwise request the missing execution fact.

records.label: In-plan Roth conversion of eligible retirement funds
records.semantic_scope: source and destination compartments + same employer plan + tax year + dated conversion event + tax/basis character
records.canonical_authority: existing D1 domain operation kind=conversion with samePlanConfirmed, source/destination holdings and eligibility acceptance
records.resolution_policy: Source/destination plan identity, pre/post-tax character and actual basis must agree; confirmation of same plan is one scoped attestation, not repeated in every mirror. Conversion is not spending or new annual contribution; tax recognition and payment are separate.

records.label: Direct or split rollover between supported retirement accounts
records.semantic_scope: source account/holding + destination account(s)/holding(s) + dated operation + eligible tax and basis character
records.canonical_authority: existing D1 domain operation kinds direct_rollover and mixed_rollover with explicit pre-tax/Roth destinations and acceptance
records.resolution_policy: Direct and split rollovers share the same transfer owner; only show Roth/after-tax destination fields for split character. Preserve basis and eligibility, link both accounts, no duplicated ordinary contribution, income or spending.

records.label: Participant distribution and linked 60-day rollover completion
records.semantic_scope: distribution event ID + owned retirement source + proceeds bank + tax year + deposit event ID + destination holding + replacement funding
records.canonical_authority: existing D1 domain operations indirect_distribution and indirect_deposit linked by original operation ID; explicit receipt, 20% withholding and replacement amount
records.resolution_policy: One auditable workflow with distinct actual distribution and follow-up rollover-deposit events. Link deposit to the original receipt and deadlines; withheld cash, replacement funding and limits retain their existing legal meaning. Do not create phantom refunds or treat the rollover as new contribution.

records.label: Term-life policy identity, insured, beneficiary and coverage terms
records.semantic_scope: insurance policy ID + owner/insured person + beneficiary + coverage-effective start/end + policy family
records.canonical_authority: existing canonical Insurance object term_life_lump_sum; owner_id, insured_person_id, beneficiary_id, coverage start/end, actual policy source
records.resolution_policy: Single policy editor owns the contract and insured/beneficiary relationships. A term benefit is conditional protection, NOT current household net-worth asset or ordinary investment. Unsupported cash value, transfer-for-value and installment-interest terms explicitly gated.

records.label: Term-life premium amount, cadence and payment source
records.semantic_scope: policy ID + premium schedule/amount/frequency + effective date + funding cash account
records.canonical_authority: existing Insurance premium, premium_frequency, premium_account_id and D1 insurance premium settlement adapter
records.resolution_policy: Premium is authored ONCE with policy, appears as ordinary insurance spending and a bank outflow once, not a second Expense object. Cash flow schedule derives from premium/frequency/coverage only when complete; zero and missed funding are not presumed paid.

records.label: Contracted term-life death benefit and settlement destination
records.semantic_scope: policy ID + beneficiary + agreed face amount + settlement bank account + covered triggering event
records.canonical_authority: existing Insurance coverage_amount, benefit_account_id, beneficiary_id and D1 deterministic death benefit payout adapter
records.resolution_policy: Benefit amount and destination are edited beside the policy; the payout is computed only if the separately owned event actually occurs within valid coverage. No extra Income editor, no assumed mortality, no cash balance before payment, and beneficiary identity is shared with the policy.

records.label: Scheduled insured death or other supported life-event trigger
records.semantic_scope: insured person + dated event ID + scenario + event enabled status
records.canonical_authority: canonical Event event_type=death, trigger_type=scheduled; policy death_event_id is only a reference
records.resolution_policy: The scenario event is distinct from the policy contract. Edit it in the same Life Events editor opened contextually from Insurance; choosing a policy does not automatically assert death. Existing policy-linked legacy death events retain IDs/links and do not cause an extra payout.
